entries.name: Sabrina Conrad
entries.content:
A skunk, who is something of a nerd, wearing non-fashionable thick black glasses, lovingly collecting Transformers toys, and working on her beloved and frustrating Amiga computer (which does cause her some social insecurity here and there with PC and Mac users).

Appearance
Sabrina's usual attire normally consists of a blue t-shirt, aforementioned glasses, and a pair of pants that match the fur pattern of the portions of her body they cover, so much so that she appears to be wearing no clothing on her lower body at all, which has elicited a few jokes.

Biography
The oldest and firstborn child of Warren and Endora Skunk, Sabrina has one younger sister, Tabitha. As a child, Sabrina had, and still has, a love for Transformers toys, but her parents, being concerned with their daughter's interest in boys' toys, never bought any for her.

During middle and high school she became very interested in computer technology, and as the years went by she became talented at the keyboard and after college used that talent to become a web designer. However, after the first two weeks at her new job, she was dismissed because the company had found a "cheaper way" of getting the job done (via pre-made clip art).

She was at a time the roommate of Amy Squirrel-Woolfe (Amy the Squirrel), her husband Thomas Woolfe, and son Timothy Squirrel-Woolfe (Timmy).

Zig Zag Studios
While looking through the newspaper for job articles, she found an ad for a local movie studio looking for a computer graphics designer. Needing a job, she immediately responded, but to Sabrina's shock, the studio was Double Z Studios, an adult entertainment studio.

After meeting the boss, Zig Zag, a white tiger/striped skunk hybrid, Sabrina nervously took the job designing the studio's website, and nervously because Sabrina is the last person you'd ever find in a place like that. But not wanting to lose her new job as quickly as her last one, and seeing that her new job has great pay at the end of each week, she puts up with her job and her boss.

R.C. Raccoon
While in an online chat room, she met a raccoon named R.C. who is an I.T. tech support worker.

Since Sabrina also worked with computers, it was a perfect match, and after building a good relationship online, they finally met face-to-face at sci-fi convention. Later, after meeting in a restaurant, they went back to Sabrina's home. Since they had already built a strong relationship online, they had come to the point where they trusted and loved each other enough to give themselves to each other.

Sabrina and R.C. have been a close and romantic couple since that point. The two later married and eventually had a skunk/raccoon hybrid daughter named Danielle Conrad.

Kathryn Darkholme, or Darke Katt, is best known as the cranky, foul-mouthed janitor at ZZ Studios. She grew up bouncing from orphanage to orphanage, not knowing if she had parents, much less who they were. Upon turning eighteen, she was cast out onto the street, becoming one of the city's homeless. It was a rough life, where trust only led to others taking advantage. After nearly a year of living on the street, Darke got into an altercation with Zig Zag, damaging her fur and her ability to work on-screen for a while. As compensation, Zig put her to work cleaning up the studio, which became a regular job, and the means to a more stable life.

Her rough early life made Darke unable to fully trust anyone. She often exhibits hostility towards others, seemingly as a defense mechanism to push people away before they can cause her harm. She's had some relationships in and out of the studio, her most recent and notable being Tamar the Ebony Leopard, but they rarely last very long due to her sharp tongue and sharper claws. She complains profusely about having to clean up after porno shoots at the studio, but deep down she thanks Zig Zag for giving her the job, and taking her off the street. She'd never say that to her face though. Oddly, Darke has never showed interest in appearing in the studio's videos, and Zig Zag has never offered either.

Cathy is a talented and passionate hairdresser and makeup artist, though she hides it behind modesty, dark clothing, and a snarky deadpan personality. Her more passionate side shows when she's around her husband, and the love between the two is apparent to all. Not surprisingly, Zig Zag has offered her work as on-screen talent, but she prefers to remain behind the scenes.
